rows.label: Pet training, care and evolution
rows.interpretation: Pet XP and growth are distinct from shinobi stats; sealed timers protect completion. C2 fixed with owner-approved additive Den/Yard bonus on new sessions; old sealed sessions retain their reward.

rows.label: Breeding, hatch, sanctuary and starter
rows.interpretation: Server-sealed offspring/traits/palette, parent eligibility, timer and custody are separate from combat.

rows.label: Expeditions, world exploration and chests
rows.interpretation: Activity-specific timers/admission and server-owned loot pools; no shared combat victory assumed.

rows.label: Road events, interludes and built-in event claims
rows.interpretation: Canonical road/event identity and one-time records; user-authored event IDs do not authorize rewards.

rows.label: Clan missions, upgrades, mentorship and Exchange
rows.interpretation: Clan XP, treasury, War Supply and Clan Points are distinct stores. C3/C4 fixed for new protocols with server-bound co-written proofs and local interruption tests; historical ambiguity remains unresolved.

rows.label: Legacy, Sage, trials, achievements and Hall
rows.interpretation: Server-owned progress and one-time milestone/title/card entitlements; retain intentional per-activity anti-farm rules.

rows.label: Village orders, agendas, upgrades, Anbu and map control
rows.interpretation: Shared village state and individual entitlements have distinct claim identities and receipts. No change to war or economy amounts.
